verdict.summary: Round 2 remains sound. The parser accepts only the documented non-negative, integer-second day/time subset; enforces component placement, ordering, uniqueness, and a nonempty time section; and uses checked parsing, multiplication, and addition to fail closed on overflow. The focused tests exercise the real parser across exact accepted values and nominal, negative, malformed, fractional, and overflowing rejection cases. Ontology, API documentation, diagnostics, and the trust-graph skill consistently state the narrowed semantics. No prior findings existed and no new findings were introduced.
